The 2025–26 season was the 120th season in the history of Chelsea Football Club, and their 34th consecutive season in Premier League as well as their 37th consecutive season in the English top flight. In addition to the domestic league, the club participated in the FA Cup, the EFL Cup and the UEFA Champions League, returning to the latter competition for the first time since the 2022–23 season.

FA Cup

[edit]
Main article: 2025–26 FA Cup

As a Premier League club, Chelsea entered the competition in the third round, and were drawn away to Charlton Athletic.[186] They were then drawn away to Hull City in the fourth round,[187] away to Wrexham in the fifth round,[188] and at home to Port Vale in the quarter-finals.[189] Chelsea faced Leeds United in the semi-finals at Wembley,[190] and played Manchester City in the final, ultimately losing 1–0.

[edit]
Main article: 2025–26 EFL Cup

As one of the Premier League clubs competing in a European competition, Chelsea entered the competition in the third round, and were drawn away to League One club Lincoln City.[191][192] They were then drawn away to Wolverhampton Wanderers in the fourth round,[193][194] and away to Cardiff City in the quarter-finals.[195][196] A two legged-tie against Arsenal was drawn for the semi-finals, with the first leg at home and second leg being away.[197]
